mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST YoY growth exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals strong economic growth, boosting investor sentiment and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% YoY, it signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% YoY, it signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY declines by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.
